title: Re-executing Coding-Agent Evaluations: Unchanged Decisions and Unresolved Policy Risk
title_zh: 重新执行编码智能体评估：决策未变，政策风险未解

paragraphs.en: Executable tests grade large language model (LLM) coding-agent patches for leaderboards, rewards and self-improvement. Two preregistered re-execution studies returned negative results. SWE-bench Pro v1’s offline option rejected none of 59 accepted Go patches whose grading configuration changed. Their exploratory, unweighted upper confidence limit is 4.95% under candidate independence, leaving a 3% exposed-patch risk unresolved; the preregistered estimator uses inverse sampling-probability weights. An extension was inconclusive. In a selected stratum, a reconstructed module cache built from the reference solution’s dependencies rejected accepted alternatives from four models that passed with their own dependencies. Re-executing 1,929 selected agent-version/task evaluations from the Darwin Gödel Machine’s archive preserved best-agent selection and system-variant ranking, with search history and scores of evaluations not rerun fixed. Exploratory host, image and adapted-grader comparisons also preserved them. Seven of 23 disagreements with archived verdicts did not recur on a second host; rebuilt images changed 16 three-run majority verdicts (0.83%) under four-CPU execution. We provide an evidence-to-claim summary, lessons for grader audits and an anonymous replication package. These results concern accepted patches and fixed-history decisions; general policy safety and adaptive-learning robustness require broader evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行测试通过排行榜、奖励和自我改进来评估大型语言模型（LLM）编码智能体的补丁。 两项预先注册的重新执行研究得出了负面结果。 SWE-bench Pro v1 的离线选项未拒绝任何 59 个已接受的 Go 补丁，尽管其评分配置发生了变化。 在候选项独立的情况下，其探索性、无加权的上置信限为 4.95%，仍有 3% 的暴露补丁风险未得到解决；预先注册的估计器使用逆采样概率权重。 一项扩展研究未能得出明确结论。 在一个选定的分层中，根据参考解决方案的依赖关系构建的重建模块缓存拒绝了一些模型所接受的替代方案，而这些模型使用自身依赖关系时通过了测试。 重新执行来自达尔文哥德尔机器存档中的 1,929 个选定的智能体版本/任务评估，保留了最佳智能体选择和系统变体排名，同时未重新运行的评估的搜索历史和分数保持不变。 探索性的主机、镜像和自适应评分器比较也保留了这些结果。 与存档判定不一致的 23 个案例中，有 7 个在第二台主机上并未再次出现；在四核 CPU 执行环境下，重建的镜像改变了 16 个三次运行中的多数判定（0.83%）。 我们提供了一份证据与主张的摘要、评分器审计的经验教训以及一个匿名复现包。 这些结果涉及已接受的补丁和固定历史的决策；通用策略安全性和自适应学习的鲁棒性需要更广泛的评估。

paragraphs.en: Executable tests decide whether a large language model (LLM) coding agent solved a task. Their verdicts feed leaderboards, agentic reinforcement learning (RL; Du et al., 2026 ) and self-improvement selection ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Verdicts depend on patches, grader images, caches, network policy, reference test lists and execution resources. Network restrictions close routes agents used to retrieve solutions ( Huang et al., 2026b ) ; packaging dependencies removes reliance on external network state ( Du et al., 2026 ) . Passing the reference (gold) patch validates only that solution: the same configuration may reject another accepted patch. We test the consequences for recorded verdicts and decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行测试用于判断大型语言模型（LLM）编码智能体是否解决了某项任务。 这些测试结果会输入排行榜、智能体强化学习（RL；Du et al., 2026）以及自我改进选择机制（Zhang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025）。 测试结果的判定取决于补丁、评分器图像、缓存、网络策略、参考测试列表和执行资源。 网络限制会阻断智能体用于获取解决方案的路径（Huang et al., 2026b）；而打包依赖项则能消除对外部网络状态的依赖（Du et al., 2026）。 通过参考（标准）补丁的验证仅能证明该解决方案有效：同一配置可能会拒绝另一个已被接受的补丁。 我们测试了这些情况对已记录测试结果和决策所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: We preregistered two questions, sealing their protocols, code and inputs in pushed commits before confirmatory data collection. Study 1 replays officially accepted SWE-bench Pro v1 patches ( Deng et al., 2026 ) under its evaluator’s offline option. It tests whether confirmed reversible losses reach 3% on policy-valid tasks. Study 2 re-executes the SWE-bench evaluations released with the Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ). It tests whether rerun instability or central processing unit (CPU) contention changes the best recorded agent version or ranks its three system variants (arms) differently. Both protocols predicted negative outcomes. Study 1 warned that a negative result would not establish absence of an effect; Study 2 disclosed a separate project’s pilot with no verdict flips on 194 evaluations of DGM’s best agent version.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在确认性数据收集之前，预先注册了两个问题，并将它们的协议、代码和输入提交到已推送的提交中加以封存。 研究 1 在其评估器的离线选项下重新运行了官方接受的 SWE-bench Pro v1 补丁（Deng et al., 2026）。 它测试已确认的可逆损失在策略有效任务上是否达到 3%。 研究 2 重新执行了随 Darwin Gödel Machine（DGM；Zhang et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2025）一同发布的 SWE-bench 评估。 它测试重新运行时的不稳定性或中央处理器（CPU）竞争是否改变了记录的最佳智能体版本，或者是否以不同方式对其三种系统变体（分支）进行排序。 两种协议都预测了负面结果。 研究 1 警告称，负面结果并不能证明效应不存在；研究 2 披露了一个独立项目的试点结果，在对 DGM 最佳智能体版本的 194 次评估中未出现任何判定翻转。

paragraphs.en: Study 1 observed no losses among 59 exposed Go patches on 25 tasks; the other 222 evaluable patches faced identical configurations. The exposed-sample upper limit is 4.95% under candidate independence; the extension was inconclusive. A reconstructed gold-bound cache rejected 6 of 15 accepted patches in a selected stratum, all recovered with their own allowed dependencies. paragraphs.en: Coding benchmarks and the RL environments built from them score a solution by applying the agent’s patch to a repository snapshot and running tests in a container: SWE-bench requires originally failing tests to pass ( FAIL_TO_PASS ) and originally passing tests to keep passing ( PASS_TO_PASS ) ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , SWE-rebench validates tasks in containers with an image per task ( Badertdinov et al., 2025 ) , SWE-bench Pro targets harder, long-horizon problems ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , Multi-SWE-bench adds languages ( Zan et al., 2025 ) , and Lego-RL uses the verdict as a terminal binary reward ( Du et al., 2026 ) . The verdict comes from the tests and from everything around them: the image, the dependency resolver, the network, and the limits on CPU, memory and time.
paragraphs.zh: 编码基准测试以及由此构建的强化学习环境通过以下方式对解决方案进行评分：将智能体的补丁应用于仓库快照，并在容器中运行测试。SWE-bench 要求原本失败的测试通过（FAIL_TO_PASS），而原本通过的测试仍需保持通过（PASS_TO_PASS）（Jimenez 等，2024）；SWE-rebench 在容器中按任务验证任务（每个任务使用一个镜像）（Badertdinov 等，2025）；SWE-bench Pro 针对更困难、长期规划的问题（Deng 等，2026）；Multi-SWE-bench 增加了多种语言支持（Zan 等，2025）；而 Lego-RL 则将判定结果用作终端的二元奖励（Du 等，2026）。 判定结果来自测试本身以及与之相关的一切因素：镜像、依赖项解析器、网络，以及对 CPU、内存和时间的限制。

paragraphs.en: Two pressures push graders offline. Packages downloaded at grading time make results depend on mutable external repositories ( Silva et al., 2024a ) , and open egress lets an agent fetch the upstream fix: DSec reports agents that used module proxies to retrieve code from GitHub ( Huang et al., 2026b ) . Lego-RL packages test dependencies into task images ( Du et al., 2026 ) , SWE-rebench V2 pre-builds task environments ( Badertdinov et al., 2026 ) , the SWE-bench Pro evaluator offers a no-network flag while the maintainers’ latest protocol keeps network access because some Go tasks fetch modules at test time ( Scale AI, 2026 ) , and SWE-Bench Pro Verified blocks code-hosting domains but keeps the dependency services builds need ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Such designs can be validated by checking that the gold patch still passes and the empty patch (no agent changes) still fails. A gold-bound hermetic grader uses the gold patch’s dependencies without network access; an alternative needing another version can fail to build and receive a wrong fix’s verdict. Lego-RL’s tooling states this limit for SWE-bench Pro tasks whose gold patch bumps a Go module: its cache is resolved from the gold module manifest ( go.mod ), so “a correct fix that bumps a module to a different version than gold still cannot download it” ( LegoX, 2026 ) . In RL the same error assigns a failed rollout’s reward to a solved one. Prior work models false-negative rewards from imperfect verifiers ( Cai et al., 2025 ) ; this error is structured, because it falls on solutions whose dependencies differ from the gold patch’s.
paragraphs.zh: 有两种压力会导致评分器离线运行。 在评分时下载的包会使结果依赖于可变的外部仓库（Silva 等，2024a），而开放的出口则允许智能体获取上游修复方案：DSec 报告称，有智能体使用模块代理从 GitHub 获取代码（Huang 等，2026b）。 Lego-RL 将依赖项打包到任务镜像中（Du 等，2026），SWE-rebench V2 预构建任务环境（Badertdinov 等，2026），SWE-bench Pro 评估器提供了一个禁用网络的标志，但维护者最新的协议保留了网络访问权限，因为某些 Go 任务在测试时会下载模块（Scale AI，2026），而 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 会阻止代码托管域名，但保留构建所需的依赖服务（Zheng 等，2026）。 此类设计可以通过验证黄金补丁是否仍能通过测试，以及空补丁（无智能体修改）是否仍会失败来确认。 一个绑定黄金补丁的封闭评分器会在无网络访问的情况下使用黄金补丁的依赖项；另一种需要不同版本的替代方案可能无法构建，并得到错误修复方案的判定结果。 Lego-RL 的工具说明指出，对于其黄金补丁升级了 Go 模块的 SWE-bench Pro 任务存在这一限制：其缓存是从黄金模块清单（go.mod）解析的，因此“一个将模块版本升级到与黄金版本不同的正确修复方案仍然无法下载该模块”（LegoX，2026）。 在强化学习中，同样的错误会将失败运行次数的奖励分配给一个已解决的方案。 先前的研究将不完美验证器导致的假阴性奖励进行了建模（Cai 等，2025）；这种错误具有结构性，因为它影响的是依赖项与黄金补丁不同的解决方案。

sents.en: Two pressures push graders offline.
sents.zh: 有两种压力会导致评分器离线运行。

sents.en: Packages downloaded at grading time make results depend on mutable external repositories ( Silva et al., 2024a ) , and open egress lets an agent fetch the upstream fix: DSec reports agents that used module proxies to retrieve code from GitHub ( Huang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 在评分时下载的包会使结果依赖于可变的外部仓库（Silva 等，2024a），而开放的出口则允许智能体获取上游修复方案：DSec 报告称，有智能体使用模块代理从 GitHub 获取代码（Huang 等，2026b）。

sents.en: Lego-RL packages test dependencies into task images ( Du et al., 2026 ) , SWE-rebench V2 pre-builds task environments ( Badertdinov et al., 2026 ) , the SWE-bench Pro evaluator offers a no-network flag while the maintainers’ latest protocol keeps network access because some Go tasks fetch modules at test time ( Scale AI, 2026 ) , and SWE-Bench Pro Verified blocks code-hosting domains but keeps the dependency services builds need ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Lego-RL 将依赖项打包到任务镜像中（Du 等，2026），SWE-rebench V2 预构建任务环境（Badertdinov 等，2026），SWE-bench Pro 评估器提供了一个禁用网络的标志，但维护者最新的协议保留了网络访问权限，因为某些 Go 任务在测试时会下载模块（Scale AI，2026），而 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 会阻止代码托管域名，但保留构建所需的依赖服务（Zheng 等，2026）。

sents.en: Such designs can be validated by checking that the gold patch still passes and the empty patch (no agent changes) still fails.
sents.zh: 此类设计可以通过验证黄金补丁是否仍能通过测试，以及空补丁（无智能体修改）是否仍会失败来确认。

sents.en: A gold-bound hermetic grader uses the gold patch’s dependencies without network access; an alternative needing another version can fail to build and receive a wrong fix’s verdict.

sents.en: In RL the same error assigns a failed rollout’s reward to a solved one.
sents.zh: 在强化学习中，同样的错误会将失败运行次数的奖励分配给一个已解决的方案。

sents.en: Prior work models false-negative rewards from imperfect verifiers ( Cai et al., 2025 ) ; this error is structured, because it falls on solutions whose dependencies differ from the gold patch’s.

paragraphs.en: Each preregistration fixes a decision rule, called a gate: a complete, valid result below its thresholds is a KILL (the hypothesis is not supported), and a result that fails its protocol’s completeness or validity conditions is INCONCLUSIVE. H1 (Study 1): under SWE-bench Pro v1’s offline option, the weighted rate of confirmed reversible verdict losses among evaluable accepted candidates on tasks where the policy is valid is at least 3% (Section 3 ). The initial protocol predicted a KILL (subjective probability about 0.85), revised before any confirmatory data to about 0.65 when the feasibility stage exposed a memory-limit risk, and predicted that most Go tasks whose gold patch bumps a module would be ineligible. H2 (Study 2): rerun instability or CPU contention alone reverses a recorded DGM decision, reproducibly (Section 5 ). The preregistration predicted a KILL, with instability and contention each on at most 1% of cells. The extension of Study 1 (Section 4.3 ) has no kill rule: it dropped the 3% gate, its outcomes are “no rejection observed”, “rejection observed” or inconclusive, and it predicted that no rejection would be observed. Table 3 in Appendix G summarizes the two studies, the extension and the feasibility stratum.

paragraphs.en: A grader policy fixes what the verifier container may reach. The task image (prepared container environment, pinned by content digest), entry script, tests, parser, resolution rule and time limit stay fixed. Official verdicts came from a networked grader that downloads missing Go modules. Our containers have no network, so baseline arm A0 emulates that contract. For each artefact it seeds a read-only file module proxy with the module-checksum entries in go.sum that the image’s cache lacks, then adds, round by round, every file of each module version the artefact’s own verification requests. The bytes are fetched on the host from public module proxies and checked by the Go toolchain against go.sum . A0 must reproduce the official verdict before a candidate counts. Arm A1 BLOCK (A1 in the confirmatory analysis), the restricted arm, applies the offline policy P BLOCK , which disables networking and changes nothing else ( Scale AI, 2026 ) ; it is the single confirmatory policy. Arm A2, the restored arm, provisions per candidate: it keeps the shipped image and adds the candidate’s own A0 mirror, excluding the task’s own module path (the project under repair), whose later versions could contain the fix. (In the feasibility stage, A2 added the candidate’s modules to the gold-bound cache, excluding the task’s own module path.) For Go tasks whose gold patch edits go.mod or go.sum , arm A1 LEGO applies the gold-cache policy P LEGO , our reconstruction of Lego-RL’s gold-bound module cache ( LegoX, 2026 ) . It runs the builder’s Go commands on the gold state offline, against a file mirror seeded from the gold go.sum and filled request by request until nothing new is requested; the upstream builder runs them with network access. P LEGO is analyzed descriptively. For non-Go tasks the emulation adds nothing, so A0, A1 and A2 are identical configurations and the design observes only background disagreement there. Figure 3 (Appendix G ) shows the arms and repetitions.
paragraphs.zh: 评分策略决定了验证器容器可以访问的内容。 任务镜像（已准备好的容器环境，通过内容摘要锁定）、入口脚本、测试用例、解析器、判定规则和时限均保持不变。 官方判定结果来自一个联网的评分系统，该系统会下载缺失的 Go 模块。 我们的容器没有网络，因此基准臂 A0 模拟了这一协议。 对于每个工件，它会创建一个只读文件模块代理，其中包含 go.sum 中镜像缓存所缺乏的模块校验和条目，然后逐轮添加该工件自身验证请求所需的每个模块版本的每一文件。 这些字节数据从主机上的公共模块代理获取，并由 Go 工具链与 go.sum 进行核对。 候选方案必须重现官方判定结果，才能被计入有效结果。 臂 A1 BLOCK（在确认性分析中为 A1），即受限臂，应用离线策略 P BLOCK，该策略禁用网络功能且不作其他任何更改（Scale AI, 2026）；这是唯一的确认性策略。 臂 A2，即恢复臂，为每个候选方案进行配置：它保留已发布的镜像，并添加候选方案自身的 A0 镜像，但排除任务本身的模块路径（即待修复的项目），因为该路径的后续版本可能包含修复方案。 （在可行性阶段，A2 将候选方案的模块添加到与黄金版本绑定的缓存中，同时排除任务本身的模块路径。）对于其黄金补丁会修改 go.mod 或 go.sum 的 Go 任务，臂 A1 LEGO 应用黄金缓存策略 P LEGO，这是我们对 Lego-RL 的黄金绑定模块缓存的重建（LegoX, 2026）。 它在离线状态下，基于黄金版本的 go.sum 生成的文件镜像，对黄金状态运行构建器的 Go 命令，并逐请求填充数据，直到不再有新请求；上游构建器则使用网络访问运行这些命令。 P LEGO 采用描述性方法进行分析。 对于非 Go 任务，模拟过程不会添加任何内容，因此 A0、A1 和 A2 的配置完全相同，设计在此仅观察背景差异。 图 3（附录 G）展示了各臂及其重复配置。

paragraphs.en: The research questions are: RQ1 (validity), on which tasks does P BLOCK pass the gold patch? paragraphs.en: Each arm runs three times, in a fresh container with four CPUs, 8 gibibytes (GiB) of memory, no network and the official one-hour timeout, in a seeded order interleaved across arms. A Study 1 cell is an (artefact, arm) pair and is finished if all three repetitions completed the grader invocation, with no launcher error, timeout or out-of-memory kill and with parser output. A candidate is evaluable if its task is eligible, its gold-baseline control and candidate A0, A1 and A2 cells finished, and A0 resolved it three times. It is a confirmed reversible loss if A1 BLOCK rejects it three times, A2 resolves it three times, and the restricted logs show the preregistered network-unavailability signature ( NET_RE ; Appendix C ). Candidates are weighted by their inverse within-task inclusion probability, estimated at draw time from availability alone with 20,000 fixed-seed Monte Carlo draws; the primary quantity is the weighted loss rate, with a one-sided 95% lower bound from a task-cluster bootstrap. The gate requires at least 200 evaluable candidates from at least two models and passes only if the rate is at least 3%, the lower bound exceeds 1%, and losses occur on at least five tasks. A complete, valid sample below these thresholds is a KILL. The study is invalid, and so inconclusive, if the gold patch fails any baseline run on an eligible task, if more than 10% of the drawn tasks have an unfinished control, if more than 10% have finished gold-baseline cells that do not reproduce the gold verdict, or if its integrity audit does not accept the execution records as valid (PASS); a task on which only the restricted arm fails the gold patch is merely ineligible. In the preregistered simulation, which assumed no attrition, the design would have passed with probability 0.48 (independent losses) or 0.40 (clustered losses) at a true rate of 3%, and 0.95 or 0.88 at 5%. The protocol, code, manifests, seeds, sample reservation, analysis script and predictions were sealed by a pushed commit before any confirmatory data; Appendix C gives the sealing, amendment and audit procedure.

paragraphs.en: Of 312 drawn candidates, 281 were evaluable, from seven models on 110 tasks (Table 1 ); 9 were on ineligible tasks, 11 on tasks with incomplete controls, and 11 were not reproduced by the baseline arm. No evaluable candidate lost its verdict or varied across restricted or restored repetitions. The complete, valid sample returns KILL: H1 is not supported. A preregistered sensitivity analysis that counts the unresolved candidates on eligible tasks as losses gives a weighted 3.90%; with eligibility and weights fixed, it covers only the 11 baseline-unreproduced candidates on eligible tasks. It exceeds 3% but does not establish the registered lower-bound and five-task conditions. The KILL therefore gives no safety assurance. The 31 unevaluable candidates may include policy-sensitive cases: baseline emulation can turn missing inputs into attrition.

paragraphs.en: Only the 59 evaluable Go patches on 25 tasks faced different configurations (Figure 1 a); all passed with the shipped image alone. The 222 evaluable Python, JavaScript and TypeScript patches faced identical arms, with no background disagreement. Risk bounds for the exposed patches were not preregistered. Post hoc and unweighted, the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper confidence limit is 4.95% on the rejection rate of these candidates if they are independent, 11.29% on the share of their 25 tasks with a rejection if tasks are independent, and 27.17% on the candidate rate if the 13 unevaluable Go draws count as rejections and candidates are independent. Figure 1 b shows the two zero-event bounds. None excludes 3%; 99 independent exposed candidates without a rejection would be needed. Under task independence, the same frame cannot reach 3%: even if all 91 Go tasks of the sampling frame were eligible and none rejected, the independent-task upper confidence limit would be 3.24%. This hypothetical limit of that interval does not answer the registered candidate-level question, and the design did not exercise package installation at grading time in other ecosystems.

paragraphs.en: The prefix contained one task whose gold patch bumps a Go module, with no loss under P LEGO ; the extension added four, the four on which the gold patch failed P BLOCK , and none of their nine evaluable candidates lost its verdict under the reconstructed cache. The only cache-induced rejections come from the feasibility stage, which selected 11 such tasks on purpose and is therefore no prevalence estimate. There, P BLOCK failed the gold patch on 8 of the 11 tasks, while the reconstructed cache passed it on all 11. Of 15 baseline-reproduced accepted candidates on seven of these tasks, six, on three tasks and from five runs of four models, failed all three runs under the cache and passed all three once their own admitted modules were added. On one Flipt task, candidates from three models each added a version of Masterminds/semver (v3.1.1 or v1.5.0) that is absent from the gold state’s go.sum ; each resolved three of three baseline and restored runs and none under the cache. Appendix D describes the reconstruction and the parity checks it passed.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀包含一个任务，其黄金补丁与一个 Go 模块发生冲突，但在 P LEGO 下没有失败；扩展部分增加了四个任务，其中四个任务的黄金补丁在 P BLOCK 下失败，而它们九个可评估的候选项中没有任何一个在重建缓存下失去判定结果。 唯一由缓存引起的拒绝都来自可行性阶段，该阶段特意选择了 11 个此类任务，因此不能视为流行度估计。 在这些任务中，P BLOCK 在 11 个任务中的 8 个上未能通过黄金补丁，而重建后的缓存则在全部 11 个任务上都通过了检验。 在这七个任务中，有 15 个通过基准测试的候选项被重新生成，其中六个候选项（来自三个任务和四个模型的五次运行）在缓存下三次运行均未通过，但在加入其自身已批准的模块后，三次运行全部通过。 在一个 Flipt 任务中，来自三个模型的候选项各自添加了一个黄金状态 go.sum 中未包含的 Masterminds/semver 版本（v3.1.1 或 v1.5.0）；每个候选项在基准和恢复运行中都成功解决了全部三个问题，但在缓存下则一个也未能解决。 附录 D 描述了重建过程以及它通过的奇偶校验检查。

paragraphs.en: Provisioning recovered all six feasibility-stage losses. In the confirmatory run there was nothing to recover, and the preregistered safety criterion forbids any restored-arm acceptance when both other arms reject; it failed: one officially unresolved Python candidate passed one of three restored runs after failing every other run. Its restored arm had no mirror and matched the other configurations, consistent with background flakiness; the cause was not isolated and the frozen rule counts it. No negative control was observed consuming provisioned modules (the official run scripts of 5 of the 112 tasks with a sampled negative control filter out the logged go: downloading marker), so that zero does not show such use to be absent. The labels have a limit of their own: 9 of the 112 sampled negative controls, and 3 of the extension’s 63, resolved in every run of every arm, so the replay does not reproduce the official rejection for them; we did not classify the cause.
paragraphs.zh: 配置过程恢复了可行性阶段的全部六个损失。 在确认运行中没有任何需要恢复的内容，且预先注册的安全标准禁止在两个其他分支均被拒绝时接受任何恢复后的分支；该标准未能通过：一个官方未解决的 Python 候选项在三次恢复运行中有一次通过了，而此前在所有其他运行中均未通过。 其恢复后的分支没有镜像，并且与其他配置一致，符合背景不稳定性特征；原因尚未明确，且冻结规则将其计入。 未观察到任何负对照消耗了已配置的模块（112 个任务中 5 个任务的官方运行脚本在采样负对照时过滤掉了记录中的“go: downloading marker”），因此零值并不能说明不存在此类使用。 标签本身也存在限制：112 个采样负对照中有 9 个，以及扩展部分 63 个中的 3 个，在所有分支的每次运行中均被解决，因此重播并未重现它们被官方拒绝的情况；我们未对原因进行分类。

paragraphs.en: A self-improving coding agent compares and promotes its versions using test verdicts. Study 2 asks whether a released run’s recorded decisions survive re-execution of frozen patches. A cell is one archived evaluation of an agent version on a task within a system arm; it can have multiple reruns. We separate three sources of disagreement: rerun instability, CPU contention, and drift from the archived grading environment.
paragraphs.zh: 一种自我改进的编码智能体通过测试结果来比较和升级其不同版本。 研究 2 旨在探究已发布的运行记录中的决策，在重新执行冻结补丁后是否仍然有效。 一个单元是系统分支中某项任务上对智能体某一版本的存档评估；该单元可以包含多次重跑。 我们将分歧的来源分为三类：重跑的不稳定性、CPU 竞争以及相对于存档评分环境的偏差。

paragraphs.en: DGM evaluates self-modified coding agents on SWE-bench Verified, up to 200 tasks ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Its archive ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) holds 245 agent versions (nodes), with 6,006 evaluations on 200 tasks in three arms: the full system and ablations without open-ended exploration or self-improvement. The recorded arm bests are 100/200 for the full system, the 50.0% that DGM reports, 23/59 without self-improvement and 14/60 without open-ended exploration. We reconstruct only decisions that the released code defines and the archive records. DGM’s score is the fraction of submitted tasks resolved. D1 (best-node selection) chooses the best of the eight full-system nodes evaluated on the full task set (197 to 200 submitted tasks each; recorded 100/200 against a runner-up of 87/200); D2 (arm ranking) ranks the three arms by the best score in each arm’s final archive (the arm bests above, each over its node’s submitted tasks). A decision reverses if a challenger reaches or exceeds the incumbent. The staged gate is not reconstructable: recorded history conflicts with the released threshold (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: DGM 在 SWE-bench Verified 上评估了经过自我修改的智能体，最多涉及 200 项任务（Zhang 等人，2026）。 其存档（Zhang 等人，2025）包含 245 个智能体版本（节点），并在三个分支中完成了对 200 项任务的 6,006 次评估：完整系统以及移除开放式探索或自我改进的削减版本。 记录下来的各分支最佳成绩为：完整系统为 100/200，即 DGM 报告的 50.0%；无自我改进的版本为 23/59；无开放式探索的版本为 14/60。 我们仅重构由已发布的代码定义且存档中记录下来的决策。 DGM 的得分是已完成提交任务的比例。 D1（最佳节点选择）从在完整任务集上评估过的八个完整系统节点中选择表现最佳的节点（每个节点提交了 197 至 200 项任务；记录成绩为 100/200，次佳为 87/200）；D2（分支排名）根据各分支最终存档中的最佳成绩对三个分支进行排序（即上述各分支的最佳成绩，均基于其节点所提交的任务数）。 如果挑战者的成绩达到或超过当前最优者，则决策将被推翻。 分阶段门控机制无法重构：记录的历史数据与已发布的阈值存在冲突（附录 E）。

sents.en: D1 (best-node selection) chooses the best of the eight full-system nodes evaluated on the full task set (197 to 200 submitted tasks each; recorded 100/200 against a runner-up of 87/200); D2 (arm ranking) ranks the three arms by the best score in each arm’s final archive (the arm bests above, each over its node’s submitted tasks).

paragraphs.en: Two cells showed rerun instability, and the same two are the only ones where the contention majority differs from the nominal majority; both belong to one Sphinx task (sphinx-10466). Under independence the one-sided 95% upper bound is 0.33% per cell for each quantity, and 2.35% per task (1 of 200). Neither kind of instability reversed D1 or D2, so no confirmation batch was needed and the preregistered test returned KILL. The substitutions narrowed D1’s margin at most from 13 to 12 tasks, and the arm ranking (100/200, 23/59, 14/60) did not move. Post hoc, reversing D1 would take at least 13 targeted verdict flips among replayed cells and D2’s top pair at least 7 (Appendix E ). The margins were known before the seal (13 tasks for D1; 0.110 and 0.156 in score between adjacent arms for D2), so the test asks whether DGM’s recorded endpoints survive the noise re-execution can expose and says nothing about close decisions. The result is conditional on unreplayed scores: with submitted tasks and other scores fixed, an unreplayed retained node of a lower-ranked arm would need at least 10 more resolved tasks to tie a higher-ranked arm’s best (initial, unmodified-agent nodes, called roots, lack recorded submission counts and are excluded). The two decisions are endpoints: the run’s intermediate selections are not tested, and one contention profile with three runs each isolates no causal contention effect.
paragraphs.zh: 两个单元格表现出重跑不稳定性，且只有这两个单元格的争议多数与名义多数不同；两者均属于同一个 Sphinx 任务（sphinx-10466）。 在独立性假设下，单侧 95% 上界对每个量而言为每个单元格 0.33%，对每个任务为 2.35%（200 个中占 1 个）。 这两种不稳定性均未逆转 D1 或 D2，因此无需确认批次，预注册测试返回了 KILL。 替换操作最多将 D1 的差距从 13 个任务缩小到 12 个任务，而各分支的排名（100/200、23/59、14/60）未发生变化。 事后分析表明，要逆转 D1，在重跑的单元格中至少需要 13 个目标裁决的翻转；而要逆转 D2 的前两名，则至少需要 7 个（附录 E）。 这些差距在封包前已知（D1 为 13 个任务；D2 相邻分支间的分数差为 0.110 和 0.156），因此该测试旨在判断 DGM 记录的终点是否能经受噪声重执行可能暴露的影响，且对接近的决策不作说明。 该结果以未重跑的分数为条件：在已提交的任务和其他分数固定的情况下，一个较低排名分支中未重跑但保留的节点，至少需要额外 10 个已决任务才能追平较高排名分支的最佳成绩（初始、未经修改的智能体节点称为根节点，它们没有记录提交次数，因此被排除在外）。 这两个决策是终点：此次运行的中间选择并未受到测试，且每个包含三次运行的争议配置都无法孤立出因果性的争议效应。

paragraphs.en: For 222 of 281 evaluable patches the arms were identical; only Go patches faced different dependency configurations. Random task sampling dilutes this contrast. Even all 91 Go tasks, eligible and rejection-free, would leave the independent-task bound at 3.24%. At candidate level, 99 independent exposed candidates with zero rejections suffice for a 3% upper bound. The extension reproduced 146 candidates, including two with a failing restricted run; its failed control makes the tally descriptive. paragraphs.en: The extension was inconclusive: one gold baseline run had the intermittent crash seen in both candidate rejections, and every gold run was required to pass. A preregistered stability screen could choose a repetition count k k and run the gold patch that many times in the baseline arm before any policy arm to exclude known-flaky tasks. One training pipeline retries failed gold-patch runs up to ten times ( Auras and Prime Intellect Team, 2026 ) . Such screening changes the conditional population; a later control failure would still trigger the registered invalidity rule.

paragraphs.en: The gold patch passed the reconstructed gold-bound cache on all 11 selected tasks, while 6 of 15 accepted alternatives failed it. Replaying accepted benchmark candidates under a new policy requires container time but no new labels and detects losses beyond gold-patch validation. Provisioning each candidate’s own declared dependencies after submission recovered every such loss. Validating that this policy also keeps incorrect solutions rejected remains future work; the confirmatory safety criterion was not met.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有 11 个选定的任务中，黄金补丁都通过了重构的黄金绑定缓存测试，而 15 个被接受的替代方案中有 6 个未能通过该测试。 在新策略下重新运行已接受的基准候选方案需要容器时间，但无需新的标签，并且能够检测出黄金补丁验证之外的损失。 在提交后为每个候选方案提供其自身声明的依赖项，恢复了所有此类损失。 验证该策略是否也能继续拒绝错误解决方案仍是未来的工作；确认性安全标准并未满足。

paragraphs.en: GitBug-Actions and GitBug-Java capture dependencies so builds re-execute without network ( Saavedra et al., 2024 ; Silva et al., 2024a ) , and maintainers apply the idea to grading: SWE-rebench V2 pre-builds task environments ( Badertdinov et al., 2026 ) , Lego-RL packages dependencies into task images ( Du et al., 2026 ) and mounts gold-derived Go module caches ( LegoX, 2026 ) , and an open, unmerged SWE-bench pull request (as of 2026-10-07) grades Multimodal tasks offline with bundles bound to the gold patch ( SWE-bench, 2026 ) . We test SWE-bench Pro v1’s offline option and a reconstructed Lego-RL gold-bound cache on accepted alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: GitBug-Actions 和 GitBug-Java 捕获了依赖项，因此构建无需网络即可重新执行（Saavedra 等人，2024；Silva 等人，2024a），而维护者则将这一思路应用于评分：SWE-rebench V2 预先构建任务环境（Badertdinov 等人，2026），Lego-RL 将依赖项打包到任务镜像中（Du 等人，2026），并挂载源自黄金版本的 Go 模块缓存（LegoX，2026）；此外，一个开放且尚未合并的 SWE-bench 拉取请求（截至 2026-10-07）使用与黄金补丁绑定的包束对多模态任务进行离线评分（SWE-bench，2026）。 我们在已接受的替代方案上测试了 SWE-bench Pro v1 的离线选项以及一个重构的 Lego-RL 黄金绑定缓存。

paragraphs.en: Inadequate tests admit suspicious patches ( Aleithan et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) , while test augmentation catches incorrect patches ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . A checklist finds outcome-validity violations in seven of ten agentic benchmarks and OSWorld checkers broken by website changes ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Accepted patches can diverge from developer intent ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . OpenAI estimates about 30% of SWE-Bench Pro’s public tasks are broken, including tests rejecting functionally correct submissions ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . SWE-Bench Pro Verified repairs tasks and audits possible collateral damage in anti-hacking agent runs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) ; we replay fixed accepted patches under a specified grading policy. Verdicts are compared across execution substrates ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , and benchmark ports are validated with parity experiments ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . On rewards, KAT-Coder-V2.5 traces invalid rollouts to sandbox failures ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , outages can corrupt reward signals ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , rollout infrastructure carries measurable overhead ( Graviet et al., 2026 ) , code RL environments accept incorrect solutions ( Rajan, 2026 ) , and provable false negatives of math answer verifiers trace to answer forms ( Xin, 2026 ) . The math-verifier study measures false negatives; we measure code acceptance losses under reference-valid policies. Test augmentation can overfit a reference implementation ( Li et al., 2026 ) ; Study 1 instead varies dependency availability with required tests fixed. Study 2 separates reference-label drift.
paragraphs.zh: 测试不足会导致可疑的补丁被接受（Aleithan 等，2024；Xue 等，2026），而测试增强则能识别出错误的补丁（Yu 等，2025；Li 等，2026）。 一份检查清单在十个智能体基准测试中发现了七个结果有效性违规问题，并且 OSWorld 检查器因网站变更而失效（Zhu 等，2025）。 被接受的补丁可能与开发者的意图存在偏差（Wang 等，2026b）。 OpenAI 估计，SWE-Bench Pro 中约 30% 的公开任务存在缺陷，包括测试拒绝功能上正确的提交（OpenAI，2026）。 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 修复了相关任务，并审计了反黑客智能体运行中可能产生的附带损害（Zheng 等，2026）；我们在指定的评分策略下重新执行已修复的被接受补丁。 判决结果在不同执行子系统中进行了比较（Yuan 等，2026），基准测试端口则通过一致性实验进行了验证（Shi 等，2026）。 在奖励机制方面，KAT-Coder-V2.5 将无效的执行过程追溯到了沙盒故障（Huang 等，2026a）；系统中断可能破坏奖励信号（Huang 等，2026b）；执行基础设施存在可测量的额外开销（Graviet 等，2026）；代码强化学习环境会接受错误的解决方案（Rajan，2026）；数学答案验证器可证明的假阴性问题则源于答案格式（Xin，2026）。 数学验证器研究测量了假阴性情况；我们则在参考有效的策略下测量了代码接受的损失。 测试增强可能对参考实现发生过拟合（Li 等，2026）；研究 1 则通过固定所需测试来改变依赖项的可用性。 研究 2 分离了参考标签的偏移问题。

Future work should expand exposed samples and replay adaptive search.

paragraphs.en: Both preregistered gates returned negative within their tested scope. Study 1 covers one benchmark and published runs from a few model families at one time. Its policy contrast is Go-only: 59 of 281 evaluable candidates, on 25 tasks, faced a configuration that the offline policy changes. The motivating 3% rejection risk remains unresolved. Study 2 covers one system’s archive on one benchmark, with cells from three repositories (Appendix E ). Broader benchmark and archive coverage would allow future studies to test how these findings generalize, including the effects of intermittent failures and adaptive search. The extension remains inconclusive because its registered control failed; its tally is descriptive.

paragraphs.en: Official test acceptance is the operational correctness criterion in this study. Our claims concern acceptance losses, the quantity a reward or leaderboard consumes; semantic correctness requires separate validation. Officially unresolved candidates are negatives under this test oracle. The baseline emulates the networked contract with a file mirror, and candidates needing resources beyond that emulation enter attrition. The reconstructed gold-bound cache matches the needed module versions in the upstream builder’s cache; file identity was not checked. Semantic review and file-level cache comparisons would extend the evaluation of accepted and unresolved patches.
paragraphs.zh: 官方测试通过是本研究中的运行正确性标准。 我们的主张涉及通过损失，即奖励或排行榜所消耗的数量；语义正确性需要单独验证。 官方未解决的候选项在此测试判据下被视为负例。 基线模型通过文件镜像模拟网络化的合约，而需要超出该模拟范围资源的候选项则会进入淘汰阶段。 重构的与黄金绑定的缓存与上游构建器缓存中所需的模块版本相匹配；文件身份未进行检查。 语义审查和文件级缓存比较将延长对已通过和未解决补丁的评估。

paragraphs.en: Study 1 uses three repetitions per arm in fresh containers, baseline reproduction of the official verdict, eligible controls and a network-unavailability signature. The extension retains the controls but counts any failed restricted run, a broader rejection rule. Selection requires baseline reproduction and eligibility. Study 1’s 31 unevaluable candidates, including out-of-memory kills, enter attrition rather than the rejection count. A preregistered baseline stability screen could address intermittent failures in future replays, provided the change in the eligible population is reported. Replaying excluded cases with larger resource budgets would help characterize attrition.
paragraphs.zh: 研究 1 在新鲜容器中每臂使用三次重复，包括官方裁决的基准重现、合格对照组以及网络不可用性特征。 扩展版本保留了对照组，但会将任何失败的受限运行计入其中，这是一种更广泛的拒绝规则。 筛选要求满足基准重现和合格条件。 研究 1 中 31 个无法评估的候选者（包括因内存不足而终止的情况）会被归入流失而非拒绝计数。 一项预先注册的基准稳定性筛查可能有助于解决未来重演中的间歇性故障，前提是报告了合格人群的变化。 使用更大的资源预算重新运行被排除的案例，将有助于明确流失的具体特征。

paragraphs.en: The preregistered gate decisions are the confirmatory claims. Post-hoc bounds and secondary analyses are exploratory; the Clopper-Pearson bounds assume independent units. A tally below a gate does not supply an upper confidence bound, and repeated runs do not increase the number of independent tasks. Future sampling plans should target enough independent, policy-exposed units to resolve the chosen tolerance. Characterizing rare intermittent failures requires more than the three runs per profile used here. Network-isolated replays fail network-dependent tests by construction; we classify these differences as drift, separately from instability.
paragraphs.zh: 预先注册的阈值决策即为确认性主张。 事后界和次要分析属于探索性分析；Clopper-Pearson 界假设各单元相互独立。 低于某一阈值的计数无法提供上限置信界，重复运行也不会增加独立任务的数量。 未来的抽样计划应确保获得足够多、相互独立且暴露于政策下的单元，以解决所选容限问题。 要描述罕见的不间断故障，需要比此处每个配置文件使用的三次运行更多的试验。 网络隔离的重播由于构造上的原因会失败于依赖网络的测试；我们将这些差异归类为漂移，与不稳定性区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The gold-bound cache rejected 6 of 15 accepted candidates in a deliberately selected feasibility stratum. These cases establish that the configuration can flip an accepted verdict; prevalence estimation requires a representative sample. Study 2’s original drift count describes one execution, and the second execution reproduced only part of that drift. Controlled host, image and pytest substitutions would help attribute these differences; the present comparisons identify neither a host-specific cause nor which verdict is correct. The suite-incompleteness rules are diagnostic heuristics, and the test-infrastructure intervention leaves edits already present in an image intact (Appendix I ). Causal tests of those edits require separate image interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 在刻意选定的可行性层级中，受黄金约束的缓存拒绝了 15 个已接受候选者中的 6 个。 这些案例表明，该配置可以推翻已接受的裁决；流行度估计需要一个具有代表性的样本。 研究 2 最初的漂移计数描述了一次执行，而第二次执行仅再现了其中一部分漂移。 对主机、镜像和 pytest 进行受控替换将有助于归因于这些差异；当前的比较既无法确定特定于主机的原因，也无法判断哪个裁决是正确的。 套件不完整规则是诊断启发式方法，而测试基础设施的干预不会改变镜像中已存在的修改（附录 I）。 对这些修改进行因果测试需要独立的镜像干预。

paragraphs.en: This work re-executes publicly released evaluation artefacts: a benchmark’s own task images and tests, officially accepted candidate patches from public leaderboard runs, and one released self-improvement archive. It recruits no participants and studies no people; the run records contain public identifiers from the benchmark repositories: commit hashes, commit authors’ names and module paths that can include account names. All candidate code and all benchmark tests run inside network-isolated containers, because the material is third-party code of unknown provenance and the experiment must not reach the network.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作重新执行了公开发布的评估成果：基准测试本身的任务图像和测试、来自公开排行榜运行的官方认可候选补丁，以及一个已发布的自我改进存档。 它没有招募任何参与者，也没有研究任何人；运行记录包含来自基准测试仓库的公开标识符：提交哈希、提交作者姓名以及可能包含账户名的模块路径。 所有候选代码和所有基准测试都在网络隔离的容器中运行，因为这些材料是来源不明的第三方代码，而实验必须不能接触网络。

paragraphs.en: We release verdicts, identifiers and content hashes, not third-party artefacts: candidate patches, task files, reference solutions, module caches and the released archive are not redistributed, so the replication package neither relicenses other people’s code nor republishes benchmark solutions that could leak into training data. The grading code we re-execute is released under MIT (the SWE-bench grader and the SWE-bench Pro evaluator); DGM and Lego-RL, whose patch filter and cache builder we reimplement, are Apache-2.0; the benchmark datasets’ cards state no licence (checked 2026-10-02), and we use them only to evaluate, as intended.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布的是判决结果、标识符和内容哈希，而非第三方产物：候选补丁、任务文件、参考解决方案、模块缓存以及已发布的存档均不会重新分发，因此该复制包既未重新许可他人的代码，也未重新发布可能泄露到训练数据中的基准测试解决方案。 我们重新执行的评分代码采用 MIT 许可证（SWE-bench 评分器和 SWE-bench Pro 评估器）；DGM 和 Lego-RL 的补丁过滤器与缓存构建器由我们重新实现，这两者均采用 Apache-2.0 许可证；基准数据集的说明中未指定任何许可证（于 2026-10-02 核实），且我们仅按预期用途使用它们进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We provide an anonymized replication package as separate software and data archives in the supplementary material. A ledger lists per-run outcomes; a manifest lists input identifiers and content hashes, fingerprints of file bytes. The package contains the sampling frames, the metadata-only reservation of Study 1’s sample, the pinned image digests, the harness, analysis and figure scripts, both preregistrations of Study 1 and Study 2’s preregistration with their dated appendices, the records of each stage’s integrity audit, and the per-run verdict records of every stage (task identifiers, candidate run names, per-arm outcomes and failure signatures), including the extension’s 380 draw records and 3,237 run records. For Study 2 it contains the archive manifest (node and task identifiers, recorded verdicts, and content hashes of the evaluated patches, logs and evaluation scripts), the frozen cell sets, the replay and grading scripts, and the verdict of every run. It also includes anonymized registrations, outcome ledgers, diagnostics and analysis code for the five Study 2 follow-ups (Appendix I ); some raw logs and patch hunks remain withheld. The extension’s report, the design-limit and negative-control analyses and all figures regenerate from these committed records (Figure 3 also needs FigureSpec, a renderer that turns JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) into vector diagrams, identified in the package’s reproduction instructions); the Study 1 and feasibility reports and the exposed-candidate bound also read raw run directories (the Study 1 report also the evaluator’s run scripts), and the Study 2 report reads the task-subset lists of DGM’s code repository, which re-running the experiments or cloning the pinned repository recreates. Candidate patches, task files, reference solutions, module caches and the DGM archive are not redistributed; the manifests record identifiers and content hashes for them. Study 1’s task images are pulled by pinned digest, and Study 2 uses locally present images pinned by image identifier. All candidate code runs only in network-isolated containers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在补充材料中以独立的软件和数据存档形式，提供了一个匿名化的复现包。 一个账本列出了每次运行的结果；一份清单则列出了输入标识符和内容哈希，即文件字节的指纹。 该包包含采样框架、仅含元数据的 Study 1 样本预留、固定的图像摘要、测试框架、分析与图表脚本、Study 1 和 Study 2 的两项预注册及其带日期的附录、各阶段完整性审计的记录，以及每个阶段每次运行的判定记录（任务标识符、候选运行名称、各分支的结果与失败特征），包括扩展部分的 380 次抽选记录和 3,237 次运行记录。 对于 Study 2，该包包含存档清单（节点和任务标识符、已记录的判定结果，以及所评估补丁、日志和评估脚本的内容哈希）、冻结的单元格集合、重播与评分脚本，以及每次运行的判定结果。 它还包括匿名化的注册信息、结果账本、诊断工具以及用于 Study 2 五次后续研究的分析代码（附录 I）；部分原始日志和补丁片段仍被保留未公开。 扩展部分的报告、设计极限与负对照分析以及所有图表，均可基于这些已提交的记录重新生成（图 3 还需要 FigureSpec，即一种将 JavaScript 对象表示法（JSON）转换为矢量图的渲染器，具体信息见该包的复现说明）；Study 1 和可行性报告以及暴露候选界限也需读取原始运行目录（Study 1 的报告还需读取评估者的运行脚本），而 Study 2 的报告则会读取 DGM 代码库中的任务子集列表，重新运行实验或克隆固定仓库即可重现这些内容。 候选补丁、任务文件、参考解决方案、模块缓存和 DGM 存档不会重新分发；清单中记录了它们的标识符和内容哈希。 Study 1 的任务图像通过固定摘要获取，而 Study 2 则使用通过图像标识符固定的本地图像。 所有候选代码均在网络隔离的容器中运行。

paragraphs.en: A container-hour is one container running for one hour; it is not a CPU-core-hour or host elapsed hour. The original studies execute CPU-only inside network-isolated containers, at most 24 at a time on one host, each pinned to four logical CPUs with 8 GiB (Study 2’s contention profile caps CPU time at a quarter of one CPU). Study 1’s confirmatory run took 93.99 container-hours (5,997 runs; Section 4 ), its extension 101.44 (the sum over its 3,237 run records), the feasibility stage 80.86 (3,315 runs), and Study 2’s replay 68.55 (11,574 runs; Section 5 ). The task images for Study 1, its extension and the feasibility stage were pinned by digest: 245 images, 235 of them pulled (about 352 gigabytes (GB) compressed); Study 2 used locally present images pinned by image identifier. No model was trained or used to assign an experimental test verdict: every such verdict comes from re-executing or regrading released artefacts. A reviewer model from a different model family ran the design and integrity audits (Appendix C ).

paragraphs.en: The gold state is the repository after applying the reference patch. Its go.mod declares module dependencies; go.sum records their checksums. The reconstruction runs the upstream builder’s go mod download -json all and go list -deps -test ./... commands on this state, in the same pinned image with the same toolchain, with a file proxy and checksum lookups disabled in place of the upstream proxy and checksum database, seeds the mirror with module metadata files ( .mod and .info ) for every module version in the gold go.sum (a registered deviation from the upstream builder; zips only on request), and repeats until they request nothing new. On all 11 tasks the last round of both commands ended without error output, and no request was a query for a module’s latest version. None of the missing module versions that the six candidates requested is in these caches or in the gold state’s go.sum . The checks support parity of the needed module versions with the upstream builder’s cache, not file-for-file parity, because running that builder requires a networked task container.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金状态是在应用参考补丁后形成的存储库。 其 go.mod 声明了模块依赖关系；go.sum 记录了这些依赖的校验和。 重建过程会在此状态下运行上游构建器的 go mod download -json all 和 go list -deps -test ./... 命令，整个过程使用相同的固定镜像和工具链，同时禁用文件代理和校验和查询（以替代上游代理和校验和数据库），为黄金 go.sum 中每个模块版本的镜像注入模块元数据文件（.mod 和 .info）（这是相对于上游构建器的一个注册偏离；仅按需打包成 zip），并重复此过程，直到它们不再请求任何新内容。 在所有 11 项任务中，两轮命令的最后一次执行均未出现错误输出，且没有任何请求查询模块的最新版本。 六个候选者所请求的任何缺失模块版本，均不存在于这些缓存或黄金状态的 go.sum 中。 这些检查确保所需模块版本与上游构建器的缓存保持一致，而非逐文件一致，因为运行该构建器需要一个联网的任务容器。

paragraphs.en: This appendix completes Section 4.3 . The extension’s unit is the task; unlike the confirmatory run, it requires no network-unavailability signature and no recovery in A2. The registered tally is two rejection tasks among 59 eligible tasks, one of them the task whose control failed; the other four tasks were ineligible because the gold patch failed the restricted arm. On both rejection tasks the candidate resolved all baseline and restored runs and failed one of three restricted runs. Because the control failed, every bound here is descriptive and the predicted zero was not observed. The one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bounds are 10.29% on the share of tasks with a rejection (2 of 59, tasks independent), 4.25% on the candidate rejection rate (2 of 146 reproduced candidates, candidates independent), and 7.31% pooled with the prefix’s 25 eligible Go tasks (2 of 84 tasks, tasks independent). Both restricted failures and the failed gold baseline run logged the same nil-pointer panic in Teleport’s lib/srv heartbeat code, with no passing required test. The panic thus also struck the baseline arm, which had the modules the restricted arm lacks, so it is not confined to the policy; how much the policy contributes is unmeasured.

paragraphs.en: A coauthor repeated all 11,574 runs on a second machine, with the documented host amendment: six four-CPU execution slots, adjusted CPU affinity (the processors assigned to each run), and scheduler priority. Both executions have complete outcome ledgers. Verdicts agree at matched run indices on 11,515 runs (99.49%, descriptive because the repetitions are independent draws). Nominal and contention majorities each differ on 10 of 1,929 cells. After validity and coverage checks, the registered reproduction criterion requires at most 1% nominal-majority disagreement, retention of every original drift cell, and unchanged reconstructed decisions. A drift cell has a recorded verdict different from its nominal rerun majority (Q2 in Section 5 ). The criterion is NOT MET: seven original drift cells no longer have that disagreement on the second machine, although nominal disagreement stays below the tolerance and the reconstructed decisions are unchanged. Those seven django-10097 cells resolve in all 42 original runs and none of the 42 second-machine runs; the latter contain database errors matching the archived failure signature. Original-host runtime and logs were not inspected for this comparison, so the cause remains unisolated. Recorded commits, patch hashes and patch-application/evaluation exit codes match on all runs; this does not establish identical runtime environments. The other differences occurred on Django cache-expiry/cache-touch tests and the Sphinx task already identified as unstable. The original-host log reading required for newly gained drift cells could not be completed.

paragraphs.en: With reference test lists fixed at dataset revision 78f471bf , SWE-bench 5.0.2 without adaptation returns not_found on all 6,006 archived logs because they lack its expected test-output delimiters. The declared adapter adds >>>>> Start Test Output and >>>>> End Test Output around each archived log, preserving the original log content, changing no grader code and supplying no test exit code. The adapted logs receive the same resolved/unresolved verdict as under the pinned grader on every cell. This comparison treats 709 adapted not_found outcomes as unresolved because the adapted logs contain no parsed test results: not_found is the grader’s status for output it does not accept as usable test evidence, rather than a third experimental verdict. Seven per-test success/failure assignments differ on cells unresolved under both graders. Thus cell-verdict agreement does not establish equivalence of the parsers or grading rules. The best node and arm ranking are unchanged, although the score gaps between challengers and the best node differ from the reconstruction using recorded verdicts. This comparison reconstructs all 96 nodes with run reports, a larger set than the final-archive node sets fixed for the original study. The three initial, unmodified-agent nodes lack recorded submission counts; their task-count denominators are recovered from their fixed scores. The comparison neither re-executes tests nor covers logs produced by the current harness or revised reference test lists.
paragraphs.zh: 由于参考测试列表已固定为数据集修订版本 78f471bf，未经调整的 SWE-bench 5.0.2 在所有 6,006 条存档日志中均返回 not_found，因为这些日志缺少其预期的测试输出分隔符。 声明的适配器会在每条存档日志前后添加 >>>>> Start Test Output 和 >>>>> End Test Output，同时保留原始日志内容，不修改任何评分器代码，也不提供测试退出代码。 经过调整的日志在每个单元格上都会获得与固定评分器下相同的已解决/未解决判定结果。 这种比较将 709 个经过调整后的 not_found 结果视为未解决，因为调整后的日志不包含任何解析出的测试结果：not_found 是评分器对于无法作为有效测试证据接受的输出的状态，而非第三种实验性判定结果。 在两种评分器下均判定为未解决的单元格中，有七项每次测试的成功/失败分配结果存在差异。 因此，单元格判定结果的一致性并不能证明解析器或评分规则是等价的。 最佳节点和臂的排名保持不变，尽管挑战者与最佳节点之间的分数差距与使用记录判定结果进行重建时的差距有所不同。 这种比较使用运行报告重建了全部 96 个节点，这一集合比原始研究中固定的最终存档节点集更大。 三个初始的、未修改智能体的节点缺少记录提交的次数；它们的任务计数分母是从其固定分数中恢复出来的。 该比较既没有重新执行测试，也没有涵盖当前测试框架或修订后的参考测试列表所产生的日志。

paragraphs.en: The scan flags a run if its log meets any of three checks: the pinned grader’s parser finds no test results; the final pytest summary reports errors and has at least as many errors as passed tests and no required FAIL_TO_PASS test has a passed/failed status; or a traceback occurs after the last result line recognized by the scan’s pattern (or no result line is recognized). A cell is flagged only when all three nominal runs are flagged. The stricter variant retains the empty-parser and error-summary checks but removes the traceback check. A revised script flags 189 of 1,929 pinned-image cells (9.8%) under the original checks and 150 (7.8%) under the stricter variant. Thirteen cells are flagged on pinned images but not rebuilt images; eight become resolved. These are log-based flags, not a causal classification of environment failures. The traceback check also flags completed suites, including 15 archived cells recorded as resolved. Neither variant captures the known django-10097 failure family. Both meet the registered reporting threshold: at least 1% of cells, with at least two exception signature families each covering at least three cells. A run’s family is its most frequent match from a fixed list of exception/warning names, or other ; a cell takes its most common run label. These are text-pattern groups. Meeting this descriptive threshold establishes neither causal attribution nor a new defect.
paragraphs.zh: 如果某个运行实例的日志满足以下三种检查中的任意一种，该运行实例就会被标记：固定版本评分器的解析器未找到任何测试结果；最终的 pytest 摘要报告了错误，且错误数量至少与通过测试的数量相等，并且没有任何必需的 FAIL_TO_PASS 测试显示为通过/失败状态；或者在扫描模式识别出的最后一行结果之后出现了堆栈跟踪（或者没有识别出任何结果行）。 仅当所有三个常规运行实例都被标记时，一个单元格才会被标记。 更严格的版本保留了空解析器和错误摘要检查，但移除了堆栈跟踪检查。 在原始检查条件下，修订后的脚本标记了 1,929 个固定版本图像单元格中的 189 个（9.8%）；而在更严格的版本中，则标记了 150 个（7.8%）。 有 13 个单元格在固定版本图像中被标记，但在重建图像中未被标记；其中 8 个最终被判定为已解决。 这些是基于日志的标记，而非对环境故障的因果分类。 堆栈跟踪检查还会标记已完成测试套件，包括 15 个记录为已解决的存档单元格。 这两种版本都无法识别出已知的 django-10097 故障系列。 两种版本都达到了注册报告阈值：至少 1% 的单元格被标记，且至少存在两个异常签名系列，每个系列覆盖至少三个单元格。 一个运行实例所属的系列，是其在固定异常/警告名称列表中匹配频率最高的项，或其他；一个单元格则采用其最常见的运行实例标签。 这些是文本模式分组。 满足这一描述性阈值既不能确立因果关系，也不能证明存在新的缺陷。

sents.zh: 满足这一描述性阈值既不能确立因果关系，也不能证明存在新的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: The scan flags files by basename: conftest.py , pytest.ini , setup.cfg , pyproject.toml , setup.py , .coveragerc , sitecustomize.py , usercustomize.py , and eval.sh , plus files ending in .pth (Python path-configuration files). Among 6,006 archive cells, 1,291 have an evaluated patch that touches one of these files. In 1,203 of those cells, the only flagged edits match dependency-version pins inserted by the harness’s pre-install commands. This classification uses strings in the added lines, rather than establishing that the agent authored those edits. A revised scan selects 59 of the 769 recorded-resolved replay cells (7.67%) for one run each after removing the flagged files’ diff blocks, meaning all patch changes for those files. Fifty-three resolve and six do not. The registered rule labels the result SUPPORTED when at least 1% of recorded-resolved replay cells touch flagged files and at least one complete-suite run becomes unresolved after block removal, compared with its archived resolved verdict. All six failures also occurred in full-patch nominal runs on both machines. Comparing against archived acceptance therefore gives no new evidence that removing a block caused the failure. Block removal also leaves environment edits already present in an image intact. This selected, one-run intervention cannot establish the absence of reward manipulation in the archive.
paragraphs.zh: 扫描通过基础名称标记文件：conftest.py、pytest.ini、setup.cfg、pyproject.toml、setup.py、.coveragerc、sitecustomize.py、usercustomize.py 和 eval.sh，以及以 .pth 结尾的文件（Python 路径配置文件）。 在 6,006 个存档单元中，有 1,291 个单元包含已评估的补丁，且该补丁涉及这些文件之一。 在这些单元中的 1,203 个单元里，唯一被标记的修改与测试框架在安装前命令插入的依赖版本固定值相匹配。 这种分类依据新增行中的字符串，而非确认智能体编写了这些修改。 经过修订的扫描在移除被标记文件的差异块后，从 769 个已记录为已解决的重复运行单元中选出 59 个（7.67%），每个单元各运行一次，这意味着这些文件的所有补丁变更均被排除。 其中 53 个得到解决，6 个未解决。 已注册的规则将结果标记为“受支持”：当至少 1% 的已记录为已解决的重复运行单元涉及被标记文件，且至少一次完整套件运行在移除差异块后变为未解决（与存档中的已解决判定相比）时。 所有 6 次失败也都发生在两台机器上全补丁的标准运行中。 因此，与存档中的接受结果进行比较无法提供新证据，证明移除某个差异块导致了失败。 移除差异块也不会改变图像中已存在的环境修改。 这种仅运行一次的干预措施无法证明存档中不存在奖励操纵。

paragraphs.en: The supplementary package contains the outcome ledgers and diagnostics used for these counts, hashes recorded when the original protocols and analysis files were fixed, and a manifest identifying changes made to anonymized export copies. Raw logs and some patch-hunk records are withheld; the export cannot regenerate every source-level diagnostic. Recorded run durations sum to 50.51 container-hours for second-host replay and 12.59 for the image comparison. The infrastructure intervention adds 59 checks whose durations are not exported. The grader comparison uses one container to grade archived logs, and the suite diagnostics scan retained logs. No model was trained or assigned an experimental verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 补充包包含用于这些计数的结果账本和诊断信息、原始协议和分析文件固定时记录的哈希值，以及一份标识对匿名化导出副本所做更改的清单。 原始日志和部分补丁块记录被保留；该导出文件无法重新生成所有源代码级别的诊断信息。 记录的运行时长总计为：第二主机重播 50.51 容器小时，图像对比 12.59 容器小时。 基础设施干预增加了 59 项检查，其运行时长未被导出。 评分器对比使用一个容器来评分存档日志，而套件诊断则扫描保留的日志。 没有模型被训练或被赋予实验性判定。

paragraphs.en: Internal reviews checked scoped follow-up analyses, claims, statistics and rejection arguments. A citation-focused check covered five added references and nine other citation contexts. These checks do not constitute an independent reproduction of the experiments or verification of every final file. A separate reproduction check regenerated ledger summaries and, with pinned dependencies and fonts, source scalable vector graphics (SVG) figures; its scope did not include re-executing experiments or certifying the full accompanying package. Font substitution can change regenerated PDF figures even when source SVGs match.
paragraphs.zh: 内部审查检查了范围明确的后续分析、索赔、统计数据以及拒绝理由。 一项以引用为重点的检查涵盖了五篇新增参考文献及另外九个引用上下文。 这些检查并不构成对实验的独立复现，也不代表对每个最终文件的验证。 一项独立的复现检查重新生成了账本摘要，并在固定依赖项和字体的情况下重新生成了源可缩放矢量图形（SVG）图表；其范围不包括重新执行实验或认证完整的配套软件包。 字体替换可能会改变再生成的 PDF 图表，即使源 SVG 图表完全一致。
